Nadia Rivera: Heads-up: rolling out a short pilot for two updates to PTO/travel processing from July 15 - Sept 15. TL;DR:
- Emergency PTO Advance: one-time advance up to 3 days for urgent caregiver/medical needs. Manager sign-off required; payroll reconciles next cycle.
- Local Trip Quick-Declare: for same-country trips under 72 hours, a simplified declaration replaces full travel preapproval (no safety checklist required).
Full details + form: https://redwood.company/hr/local-pto-travel-pilot :memo:

Tom Nguyen: Are contractors eligible?

Nadia Rivera: Eligibility: FT employees + contractors on >6mo engagements. Part-timers considered case-by-case. See FAQ in the doc.

Tom Nguyen: If we need the advance retroactively, any cutoff?

Nadia Rivera: Retro requests accepted within 10 business days, mark notes with RETRO so payroll flags it. Managers must approve.

People Ops Bot: Handbook updated at /handbook/people-ops/local-pto-travel-pilot.md — includes LMS micro-training for managers and form link.

Comp Team: Payroll note: include pay period in the form to help reconciliation.

Nadia Rivera: Thank you! We'll run a mid-pilot survey and publish metrics. DM for edge cases.
